fields.seconds: wall time of the query, from the first metadata read to the answer
fields.open_seconds: wall time to open the array (zarr.json), before the query
fields.open_requests: requests made while opening the array
fields.metadata_seconds: wall time until the zone map or indexes were read
fields.planning_seconds: planning time; with the pipeline, summed over objects
fields.payload_seconds: wall time from the first payload read to the last decode
fields.decode_seconds: decode time summed over every read, across threads, so it can exceed the wall time and must not be stacked with the others
fields.requests: requests made by the query, counted by a wrapper store
fields.bytes: bytes returned to the query, counted by a wrapper store
fields.peak_rss_kb: peak resident memory of the measuring process (VmHWM), page cache not included
fields.cgroup_peak_bytes: memory.peak of the job's cgroup, page cache included
fields.peak_inflight_bytes: most payload bytes reserved at once, from a read's start until its blocks are decoded: an upper bound on payload buffers, not memory used, since reads still downloading count too; see peak_rss_kb for memory
